title: Inner segments
description: A publisher's own signed record of the segments that ran inside one of its private nodes (REQ-ORD-41): each with the transaction it ran under, the asset and amount in and out, and the fee. It is labelled the publisher's word (REQ-ORD-3, AC-35): inside a private node there is no other witness, so a replay of the record against the public movement out shows consistency with the exit, never that the segments happened (THR-131). Its figures are recorded as the publisher states them: a record that doesn't add up is still a record, and the replay records the mismatch. It names no transaction of its own, so its stated entry is about nothing.

node.description: The private node, by its identifier: one the publisher declares (REQ-CAT-20, REQ-CAT-22).

publisher.description: The publisher whose word the record is: the statement's maker.

standing.description: The record's standing: its publisher's word, labelled as such (REQ-ORD-3). It is never proof that the segments happened.

segments.description: The segments, in the order they ran: at least one.

segment.description: One segment inside the node, as the publisher recorded it. Amounts are whole numbers of each asset's unit at the node.

transaction.description: The transaction the segment ran under.

fee.description: The fee, in the asset that went in.
